subject: POC kickoff & access plan — BlueHarbor Analytics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0000
Subject: POC kickoff & access plan — BlueHarbor Analytics

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have aligned expectations for the 4-week POC: 

Scope & success criteria (draft)
- Ingest: connect BlueHarbor event stream (sample subset of 10K rows) into Redwood’s ingestion endpoint.
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for 512-token requests under concurrent load (up to 3 RPS).
- Cost signal: token cost per request tracking and expected unit cost within 20% of baseline.
- Quality: automated eval on a 50-prompt set with target pass-rate >= 88%.

Access & operational items we need from your side
1) API keys / service account for trial: we can provide ephemeral keys scoped to the POC project.
2) IP allowlist: list of outbound IPs from your environment for webhooks (if any) and allowlist entries for Redwood control-plane.
3) SSO invites for two users (Marcus + one engineer) if you prefer SAML SSO; otherwise we’ll create local accounts.
4) Sample dataset (CSV) and a short mapping doc (column -> semantic meaning).

Ownership & timeline
- You: provide sample dataset, IP list, and confirm success criteria by Wed 9/16.
- Redwood (Marissa): setup POC project, create service credentials, and produce a baseline perf run by 9/21.
- Kickoff: tentatively 9/22 for hands-on session and run-through.

I attached a one-page success-criteria workbook to make it easy to confirm. Please reply with any edits and whether Marcus should be invited to the kickoff.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

Attachment: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.xlsx

Thanks Karthik — this is great, and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications: 

- Success criteria: can we add a qualitative check for "coherence on domain-specific prompts" (we'll share 20 example prompts) and make the eval pass-rate target 90% for that subset?
- API keys: we'd prefer a scoped service account and an API key that can be rotated. Can you confirm key rotation process and TTL?
- IP allowlist: ops will send the list (likely a /20 range plus two static IPs) — I'll loop them in.
- SSO: yes please invite Marcus and one backend engineer (I'll confirm the second name tomorrow).

We'll send the sample dataset by end of day tomorrow (9/15). Kickoff on 9/22 works for us — Marcus will join.

Best,
Elena Park

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & access plan — BlueHarbor Analytics

Elena —

Quick technical notes / what I'll provision once we have the service access form and IP list: 

1) API keys & rotation:
- We'll create a scoped service account for the POC project, with an API key TTL of 30 days by default.
- Rotation: you can request a new key from the Console; we also support automated weekly rotations for long trials.

2) IP allowlist & webhooks:
- For control-plane callbacks (status updates) you'll need to allowlist the following Redwood egress CIDRs: 34.198.12.0/22, 52.36.88.0/23 (we'll confirm final list once POC is scheduled).
- If you expect inbound webhooks from your cluster, supply the outbound IPs and we can add them to the POC project's allowed origins.

3) SSO:
- We support SAML and OIDC. If you send the IdP metadata I can send SSO invites; otherwise I'll create local accounts and share temporary passwords over the Service_Access_Form.pdf (attached).

4) Baseline perf run and data mapping:
- Once we have the CSV and schema mapping, I’ll run a baseline to produce latency/cost metrics and a quality run against your 20 domain prompts. Expect the baseline report within 3 business days of receiving data.

Attachment: Service_Access_Form.pdf

I'll create the POC project this afternoon and post the HubSpot link to the Doc we will use for tracking.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
